title: Yeh Saali Aashiqui
desc: Love becomes deadly when betrayal sparks obsession, dragging two lives into a dangerous spiral of revenge, manipulation, and the high price of passion gone wrong.

title: Flight
desc: Ranveer Malhotra fights to survive on a plane full of danger. Against all odds, he faces deadly challenges in the sky to stay alive.

desc: Chaman, a lecturer, has trouble finding a suitable bride due to his receding hairline. All hell breaks loose when an astrologer predicts that he will remain celibate if unmarried till the age of 31.

desc: Vedaa, a victim of caste discrimination, trains as a boxer under Abhimanyu's guidance. Determined to overcome injustice, she fights for justice and seeks answers behind her siblings' murder.

desc: Rashmi, a small-town girl, overcomes societal barriers and goes on to become a national-level athlete.

title: Gulaal
